findings: The repository source asks for RabbitMQ/MQ message-loss prevention, including an explicit consumer-side variant; a correct answer must cover publisher, broker and consumer failure boundaries rather than one configuration switch.

The frozen primary-source packet separates publisher confirms from consumer acknowledgements, distinguishes broker durability from routing detection, and documents retransmission/redelivery duplicate risk.

The candidate follows those boundaries: publisher confirm plus unroutable handling, durable/persistent and quorum-replication semantics, manual consumer acknowledgement, and idempotent business effects.
The candidate does not claim RabbitMQ mechanisms provide end-to-end exactly-once processing and does not fabricate deployment topology, incident metrics or project experience.
